name: Rushil Decor Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1993, Rushil Decor Ltd manufactures and sells Laminate Sheets, Medium Density Fibre Board, Pre-laminated Medium Density Fibre Board boards, and Polyvinyl Chloride Board[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
RDL is a 3 Star Export House certified manufacturer of MDF boards, Plywood 
and Laminates in organized segments. 
It has 1,200+ SKUs / Designs, 600+ 
 Direct Distributors, and 4,400+  Retailers Dealers

pros: Stock is trading at 1.08 times its book value
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of 12.3% over last 3 years.
